mapper.select: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = current_schema()
SELECT table_name || '.' || column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema()

SELECT table_name || '.' || column_name AS column_key, character_maximum_length AS max_length FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND character_maximum_length IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.conname AS constraint_name, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = current_schema() AND c.contype = 'c'
